turns.assessment: The apparent flatline is local to trx.och60.z: its rx power and all other coherent metrics are unchanged, while no optical-path monitor or far-end metric changed. A full CARD_FAIL could leave stale monitoring, but it should also remove this unit's transmitted channel at trx.och60.a; that expected corroboration is absent. O1 occurred much later on an unrelated line and does not explain the t=600 flatline. The evidence therefore favors an unlisted telemetry/data-collection issue rather than a documented equipment fault.

proposals.rationale: A failed card can make its monitoring silent, potentially appearing as values frozen at their last samples. However, the documented mode also causes loss of its transmitted channel at the far-end receiver, and trx.och60.a showed no change.
This is the only documented receiver-local soft fault, but it should cause a receiver penalty or errors rather than freeze rx_power, OSNR, BER, DGD, SOP rate, and laser bias simultaneously.
A brief span disturbance could explain O1's power excursion, but O1 is at t=960 on the S21-to-S06 line and has no demonstrated relationship to trx.och60.z or its t=600 flatline.
